details: For sign matrices with $\mathrm{VC}\geq1$; more precisely, $\mathrm{DSR}\leq2\mathrm{VC}+1$.
name: VC Dimension / Dual Sign Rank
proof: Proposition 1 gives $\mathrm{DSR}\leq2\mathrm{VC}+1$.  When $\mathrm{VC}\geq1$, this implies $\mathrm{DSR}\leq3\mathrm{VC}$, i.e. the displayed constant-factor relationship.
